title: QA run · release-18.3.0-w3-manual-api (25/25) · c4c515ad · 2026-10-29 · 23 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTp5wXse9Zwgq8aFWV
Part of #27377 (wave 3, W3-C3a)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, card W3-C3a: the manual set on the `api` · `cli` · `build` surface. Every clause was driven live over REST, CLI, MCP or a build, on a fresh showcase boot per item.

Result: 25 of 25 items judged. 23 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 0 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 NOT-RUN. No clause failed, and no security finding was raised. All four retest items hold their fixes (§ Retest). Four product defects were found by off-clause probes; they are extracted at close-out.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` @ `c4c515ad3cc342043a2b81b5a06a5793f79a23e8` (detached), which includes `ui/`. Build: cold `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build` (114/114 tasks, 10m31s). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` was green. The console was not built because no item had a browser surface.
- Boot, per item: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`, stopped by process group.
  - Items that install packages, compile, or need a broken or edited upstream booted from a scratch copy of the app (tar copy, node_modules symlinked).
  - `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` was never created.
  - `git status` was clean at the end.
- Ports 41110–41160, each with its own file DB per item. Execution was parallel: five runner subagents of five items each, one boot at a time per runner. Their verdicts were accepted only after the coordinator checked each runner's evidence strings against its transcript.
- Seed: stock showcase plus `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai). Personas:
  - the demo personas (password showcase123);
  - members minted by invite then sign-up, or by admin create-user;
  - the `search:qa-contributor-bound-member` recipe, replayed literally.

  Each persona's identity was proven with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells.
- Special boots:
  - `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` for the two identity-auth items;
  - `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=object` for the second leg of owd-save-gate;
  - a scratch copy with the MCP upstream moved away for connector-degraded-recovery, with the dispatch proven to land on that boot (the ping uptime matched /health).

  `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` was unset; no clause in this set is clock-driven.
- Timestamps: preparation started 2026-10-29T04:20Z, the build finished at 04:32Z, the runners worked 04:33–04:52Z, and the coordinator re-verified two probe findings 04:52–04:53Z.

## Scope

The selector is `release-18.3.0-w3-manual-api`, the manual-set rule of anchor #27377 §0. Each revision below is the one `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json` reported at c4c515ad. All 25 items are runnable and none is `planned`.

access-security.owd-save-gate r7 · access-security.packaged-flow-write-door-parity r4 · access-security.record-share-grant-revoke r7 · ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip r7 · ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate r5 · api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix r6 · api-backend.api-methods-verb-gate r3 · api-backend.batch-transactional-discovery r8 · api-backend.error-envelope-ledger r7 · approvals.approver-resolution-matrix r9 · approvals.decision-only-via-service r5 · attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced r7 · automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal r10 · automation.trigger-status-contract r8 · cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first r2 · cli.hook-body-extraction-gates r7 · cli.qa-suite-execution r10 · identity-auth.two-factor-disable-lifecycle r2 · identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal r3 · integration-system.connector-degraded-recovery r6 · platform-core.docs-audience-gate r3 · platform-core.manifest-install-contract r7 · platform-core.seed-mode-matrix r6 · search.rls-both-personas r8 · studio-authoring.removed-key-save-door-refusal r2

No `automated.ref` pin scored a clause in this set. Two pins were run as supporting evidence, and their layer is named where they are cited.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

Probes took about 108 runner-minutes across the 25 items, plus coordinator re-verification. Doors probed: every door the clauses drove. Personas: admin, the demo personas, minted members, anonymous, and a bad bearer. Boundary classes tried:
- empty string, missing id, unknown id and unknown name;

- wrong-object paths and cross-flow names;
- non-admin and anonymous callers on every write door.

Four product defects were found. All were reproduced twice on independent boots, and they are extracted at close-out:
1. Beside platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: when one seed in a publish batch fails, the `seedApplied` receipt reports inserted 0 and updated 0 although earlier seeds' rows were written. Later seeds in the batch are published but never applied.
2. Beside automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal: after `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/ID`, the uninstalled package's flows stay registered and triggerable in the automation engine until an unrelated metadata reload.
3. Beside approvals.approver-resolution-matrix: a `user` approver naming a nonexistent user id opens a request on a phantom slot. There is no warning, no onEmptyApprovers fork, and pending_approver_names is null, so the request is stuck.
4. Beside attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced: the sys_file lifecycle columns (status, size, mime_type) are writable through the data door. An admin PATCH marks a never-uploaded file committed, and a file field then accepts it.
